# Week 2 — Visual QA log

**Source:** `docs/pptx/week-2-builder-orientation.pptx` (28 slides, regenerated by `scripts/build_pptx_week_2.py`)

## Method
1. `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` → PDF
2. `pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80` → one JPEG per slide
3. Walked all 28 rendered pages looking for any of the Week 6 defect patterns: cover H1 → rule overlap, two-line content H1 → column / rule / card collisions, badge / title overlap.

## Defects found and fixed in `scripts/build_pptx_week_2.py`
- **None.** No slide in Week 2 exhibits any of the three Week 6 defect patterns. The deck has no two-line content H1s that would collide with the gold rule or columns, the cover title fits on one line at the configured point size, and there is no badge layout where the rule needs to clear both badge and title.

## Why no equivalent fixes were needed
- Week 6 fix #1 (cols-2 column-as-component recognition) does not apply: `scripts/build_pptx_week_2.py` does not parse `cols-2` columns whose root child is a `card`/`arch`/`prompt` component — its bespoke layouts use direct primitive renderers, not the generic column→component classifier.
- Week 6 fix #2 (cover H1 auto-shrink + rule positioned from line count) is unnecessary: every Week 2 H1 fits on one visual line at its configured point size, so a fixed title-box height does not collide with the rule or body region. No content slide overflows.
- Week 6 fix #3 (pillrow fixed-height in stacked col rendering) does not apply: Week 2's column renderer does not stack a `pillrow` underneath weighted blocks, so the weight-grabbing bug from Week 6 cannot occur here.

The deck was rebuilt as a sanity check (28 slides) to confirm no regressions versus the previous artifact; the resulting PPTX is byte-stable.

## How to re-run the QA
```sh
uv run python3 scripts/build_pptx_week_2.py
soffice --headless -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/sof-2 \
  --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/qa-week2 docs/pptx/week-2-builder-orientation.pptx
pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80 /tmp/qa-week2/week-2-builder-orientation.pdf /tmp/qa-week2/slide
```
